units.source_text: 便衣警官推了推我的后背。

en.t: The plainclothes policeman gave me a slight push in the back.

units.source_text: 我走近母亲，她的身影竟然随之渐渐变小了。

en.t: As I walked closer to my mother, her figure strangely began to grow smaller with each step.

units.source_text: 她的脸就在我的眼下，丑陋地歪着仰望我。

en.t: Her face was right below my eyes, twisted grotesquely as she looked up at me.
